title: Restore lab DNS
keywords: dns dns_failure dns_answer_mismatch dns_unreachable resolver dig port 53 SERVFAIL
preconditions: DNS to svc fails or returns a wrong A record while HTTP to the portal IP succeeds.
proposal: Ask the operator to compare svc dnsmasq with the known-good DNS configuration and validate syntax before restoring the configuration or restarting the DNS process.
verify: Verify the lab A records over UDP and TCP and verify the portal by name.
rollback: Preserve the configuration snapshot and verify the DNS state after rollback.

title: Restore the portal
keywords: web_down portal web nginx http tcp connection_failure http_status http_body_mismatch
preconditions: The portal DNS answer is correct and direct HTTP to the portal IP fails.
proposal: Ask the operator to check Nginx supervisor state and syntax, then restore the known-good site configuration or start the portal service if it is stopped.
verify: Verify the expected portal body with HTTP 200 and check guest WAN and DNS canaries.
rollback: Restore the pre-change snapshot when applicable and distinguish rollback from service recovery.

title: Review temporary lab quarantine
keywords: ids_test lab_alert_uri lab_syn_threshold suricata eve alert quarantine security evidence review
preconditions: A validated IDS event identifies the lab source IP, node, flow and destination. The operator reviews the intended scope and test classification.
proposal: Propose a temporary 120-second quarantine for the verified lab source, subject to separate operator approval.
verify: Confirm the source is blocked, an unaffected canary works and the entry expires.
rollback: An authorized operator can remove that exact quarantine element and retest.

title: Investigate gateway or VLAN connectivity
keywords: gateway_unreachable gateway vlan network route link down icmp_unreachable interface pvid
preconditions: The source cannot reach its gateway and interface or route evidence is available.
proposal: Compare the source interface, default route and switch access VLAN with the known-good topology. Escalate the discrepancy for operator review.
verify: Confirm gateway reachability followed by a service probe and a canary.
rollback: Keep the observed network state and hand off any proposed change.

title: Investigate DHCP address acquisition
keywords: dhcp_failure dhcp lease dora discover offer request ack resident guest no address
preconditions: The DHCP client is on its expected VLAN and lacks an active lease or its router/DNS options.
proposal: Review the DHCP client and server evidence, pool and VLAN mapping. Escalate if the DORA stage or configuration discrepancy is unclear.
verify: Check an active matching lease, the default route and a DNS answer.
rollback: Keep the lease and interface snapshots for operator review.

title: Investigate packet loss
keywords: packet_loss intermittent loss delay rtt transport jitter degraded
preconditions: Repeated observations show loss or variable RTT and other application canaries establish scope.
proposal: Compare loss, RTT, interface counters and DNS/HTTP canaries for the affected source.
verify: Repeat probes from the affected source and an independent canary.
rollback: Retain the relevant measurements for operator review.
